== Notes ==
* Eremite's Attack is a single [[attack]] that can [[hit]] multiple foes.
** Each target will only be hit once.
* The foes hit by this skill are those adjacent to the user, not the target.
** This attacks will fail to hit [[kiting]] opponents, including the target, if they have moved away by the time the attack would have connected.
{{bug|The full description is incorrect: a Dervish enchantment is removed even if this attack fails to hit.}}
